verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but its client-solutions page describes a Generative AI legal assistant built with Legora. That makes the axis applicable. However, the evidence is a single thin mention, and it does not show clients can delegate tasks to the assistant inside a product they use; it may be an internal firm workflow tool. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant is client-facing, any description of delegable tasks or agentic behaviour, documentation of how to access it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
